svg.text: Figure 3-16 · SW FMEA — where it stops and SOTIF starts
SWF rev 1.14 · BL-007 · draft · per element, which failures this FMEA rates and which are performance limits for SOTIF
15 top-level elements: 8 functional safety only, 7 split between this FMEA and SOTIF, 0 SOTIF only. Left of the line: software faults rated here. Right: performance limits with correct software.

Rows are the top-level elements in structure order; causes of child elements count toward their parent. A split element has software faults rated here and a performance part owned by SOTIF, quoted from `sotif.sotif_part` with its WP-C-05 reference.
The right lane says what this FMEA does not rate; it is not a claim that the SOTIF analysis covers it.
